notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Time Stretch, taking an extra two turns after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is tapped and attacking.
Mnemonic Wall enters, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
